chapter_title: The Three Earths that Exist, they bear Fruit.
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**
 Three degrees
 of the mind exist within
 the human
 being, and all
 are being cultivated by
 the
 Divine
.
 At first the
 Lord
 lab
ors within
 them as
 one
 who prep
ares the ground
.
 Afterward
 they bring
 forth genuine
 goods
 of life to
 those powers
 that labor within them.

**
¶2:** The first
 of these is the natural
 mind —
 the
 ou
termost degree in
 which human consciousness dw
ells and
 carries
 on
 its life
. The
 understanding
 is broken open there
 by
 means
 of natural
 truths applied with effort and discipline;
 the external
 thought
 is turned
 over and laid
 into
 ord
erly forms capable
 of receiving what
 is s
own from
 within.
 And
 at
 length,
 from
 a
 natural
 mind so
 reformed
, the goods
 of charity and use are gathered.


**¶3:** The second degree
 is the spiritual mind,
 the interior person,
 which
 is
 holy
.
 The
 good
 belonging
 to it is dispers
ed and
 held throughout
 every
 level
 of the mind, in
 its
 higher
 and its
 lower regions
 alike
. The powers
 that cultiv
ate it are Divine
 Love
 and Divine Wisdom, which proceed
 through
 the heavens in
 their c
easeless course
. They
 labor upon
 the
 interior person so
 as
 to draw every
 scattered
 good toward their own
 lik
eness. And that
 good
,
 so
 quick
ened,
 rises
 up and asc
ends toward heaven.
 It is
 drawn
 up
ward and
 out
 from every natural
 and sensory state
 in which it had
 l
ain captive,
 and it aug
ments the life
 of heaven
 itself
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three earths exist in the universe, and are being toiled over. At first they [receive] the farmer in them. Afterwards they bear [good] fruit to they who toil over them.

One of them is this great earth that people are living upon. They are ploughing in it [...], it with iron hoes, they cultivate, [making] the furrows, turning it over [...] Afterwards they harvest fruit from [it [ ... ]

The second field is the living soul, the holy one. It is mixed in the entire zone, above and below. The farmers who toil over it are these two great light-givers, which journey through the heavens. They are toiling and cultivating it, so that they will draw it towards their aspect. And it leaps up and comes to the heights. It goes upwards, out from every place wherein it is, and it adds to them.
